body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Motorola(www.motorola.com) unveiled a video of its first tablet PC 'XOOM' with 'Honeycomb' of Google through YouTube
According to Motorola, 'XOOM' with Dual Core processor is possible for multi-tasking and its HD 10.1-inch wide screen makes it possible to enjoy all HD contents everywhere.
In addition, when connecting with TV, users can watch TV with big screen and it's very connectable with PC accessories such as mouse and keyboard easily.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
